decisions.surface: J02 Home/People/Activity/You and incoming history; guest expense receipt return
decisions.piece_id: J02/state/home; J02/home/action/people@none; J05/success/action/back-to-group@group-updated; new wrapper controls have no exact frozen piece ID
decisions.observation: Crowded Home, stale owner dispatch and misleading group/root returns.
decisions.prediction: A clear primary task and predictable return without loss of local work.
decisions.tradeoff: Occasional tools move to their owning sections.
decisions.authority_boundary: Frozen semantics and source copies unchanged.
decisions.result: bounded local pass; user review pending

hypotheses.prediction: The focused hierarchy makes the next task easier to identify.
hypotheses.evidence_needed: User review and, if required, neutral cold-person task observations.

evidence.scope: Bounded J02 repair and UX-006 return: 78 normal-UI checks at two mobile sizes and desktop; source-aware history, root/group navigation, guest/account boundaries and retained destinations. Owner screenshot inspection, not independent review or human comprehension.
evidence.environment: Local Chrome; public synthetic code/account; one writable tab per origin; no real auth/providers/funds.

historical_sample.method: Single reviewer heuristic audit, current-run cloud Chrome interaction and screenshots; no independent usability panel or psychological performance study

sample.title: Home orientation

sample.observation: Primary start is clear; eight secondary destinations compete and look disabled.
sample.limitations: Large collections and returning real accounts not sampled.
